Practical thinking.
A clear purpose.

To make practical business thinking accessible to owners and teams, with clear questions, structured methods and attention to what the evidence supports.

Meet the author

Timothy Madu

Timothy Madu is a business owner, entrepreneur and author based in Yenagoa, Bayelsa State, Nigeria. He owns KC TIMO AUTOMOBILES. His Business Playbook Series focuses on practical questions about customer experience, revenue opportunities and business improvement.

The series is written for entrepreneurs, founders, owners, managers, consultants and professionals who want a structured way to examine business challenges.

Our publishing philosophy

Useful questions.
Considered decisions.

  • Start with the real business problem.
  • Investigate before recommending a solution.
  • Consider the costs and consequences of acting.
  • State only what the evidence supports.
